claims.text: Visitors who can't find a ballpark price tend to leave without contacting the business rather than asking directly
Hiding pricing behind 'Contact us' tends to attract price-shopping callers rather than filter them out
Posting a starting price range on the service page, GBP, and landing page is a concrete step an owner can execute in one afternoon

disclosure: Google Business Profile AI messaging pilot, reported by Search Engine Roundtable and corroborated by multiple local-search outlets

claims.text: Google is piloting AI-powered messaging on Business Profiles that lets customers message a business from Search and Maps, with an AI agent answering first
The pilot is invite-only with no announced date for a wider rollout
The AI agent answers using the business's own profile data, such as hours, services and Q&A
A thin or outdated profile risks the AI giving a wrong answer before a human ever sees the lead
Whatever the AI cannot resolve still needs a fast human or automated reply behind it
